sources.name: Upgraded Points Disney vs Pixar survey: favorite original animated Disney (non-Pixar) movie, by state. The Lion King won 25 states, Aladdin 9, Beauty and the Beast 3, Mulan 3, The Little Mermaid 1, Moana 1 (RI), The Emperor's New Groove 1 (CO). Frozen won 0.
sources.method: Survey of 3,100+ US adults, April 2022. Sequels and remakes excluded; 8 small states dropped. Ranked by states won, with ties averaged: LK 1, Aladdin 2, BatB/Mulan 3.5, LM/Moana/ENG 6. List length 7, so missing = 12.

sources.name: YouGov Disney princess poll: share of each film's viewers who 'loved' it, across 13 princess films. Moana 54%, Aladdin 50%, Brave 49% (Pixar, dropped), Beauty and the Beast 49%, Frozen 49%, Pocahontas last at 36%. The other 7 films are unnamed but are by elimination Snow White, Cinderella, Sleeping Beauty, Little Mermaid, Mulan, Princess and the Frog and Tangled. Favorite princess: Cinderella 13%, Snow White 10%, Belle 7%, Ariel 6%, Mulan 6%.
sources.method: 1,000 US adult citizens, April 2023, weighted. Disney Animation films only: Moana 1, Aladdin 2, BatB/Frozen 3.5, the seven unnamed films 8 each (positions 5-11), Pocahontas 12. Missing = 17 because the poll covered princess films only, which penalizes Lion King here. The favorite-princess figures (via 24/7 Wall St) were used in the gut check for Cinderella and Snow White.

sources.name: Tellwut 'Favorite Disney movie' poll, 1,949 votes: Lion King 20%, Beauty and the Beast 11%, Cinderella 11% (204 votes vs 217 for BatB), Little Mermaid 6%, Aladdin 5% (99), Frozen 5% (96), Mulan 3%. Top write-ins: Bambi 9, Fantasia 6, Snow White 4, Lady and the Tramp 4 (Toy Story and Brave dropped as Pixar).
sources.method: Opt-in online panel (mostly US), posted Sept 2025, closed list of 7 plus write-ins. Ranked by votes: LK 1, BatB 2, Cinderella 3, LM 4, Aladdin 5, Frozen 6, Mulan 7, Bambi 8, Fantasia 9, Snow White and Lady and the Tramp 10.5. List length 11, so missing = 16. Moana, Tangled and newer films were not options, which hurts them here.

sources.name: Nielsen year-end streaming movie charts (US). 2024: Moana #1 at 13.03B minutes, Encanto #6 at 6.61B, Frozen #7 at 6.28B. 2023: Moana #1 at 11.6B, Encanto #2 (9.7B per press), Frozen #7. Encanto was #1 in 2022 at 27.4B. 2025: Moana and Moana 2 both in the top 10.
sources.method: Nielsen measured US TV streaming minutes. 2024 top 10 read on TheDesk; 2023 read on Cartoon Brew (https://www.cartoonbrew.com/streaming/the-7-most-streamed-films-last-year-were-all-animated-237455.html). Disney Animation films in both years' top 10: Moana 1, Encanto 2, Frozen 3. List length 3, so missing = 8.

sources.name: English Wikipedia pageviews, Nov 2025-Oct 2026 (user agents). Zootopia 1.86M (boosted by the Zootopia 2 release), Moana 1.31M, The Lion King 1.16M, Frozen 945k, Tangled 876k, Encanto 764k, Lilo & Stitch 730k, Beauty and the Beast 689k, Aladdin 683k, Mulan 665k, Hercules 659k, Atlantis 621k, Little Mermaid 617k, Princess and the Frog 609k, Big Hero 6 601k, Snow White 591k ... Bambi 378k, Peter Pan 329k, Cinderella 323k, Dumbo 291k.
sources.method: Wikimedia REST API, monthly totals summed for 46 original Disney Animation features, using the 1994/1991/etc. article for each animated film rather than the remake. Ranked 1-46, missing = 51. Leans young and online, and remakes inflate some originals (Lilo & Stitch, Snow White).

sources.name: Domestic (US/Canada) lifetime box office, nominal: Lion King $422.8M, Frozen $400.7M, Zootopia $341.3M, Moana $248.8M, Big Hero 6 $222.5M, Beauty and the Beast $219.0M, Aladdin $217.4M, Tangled $200.8M, Wreck-It Ralph $189.4M, Snow White $184.9M, Tarzan $171.1M, Lilo & Stitch $145.8M, 101 Dalmatians $144.9M, Jungle Book $141.8M, Pocahontas $141.6M ... Encanto $96.1M (pandemic release), Cinderella $85.0M.
sources.method: The 'Box office grosses' table from the list's raw wikitext, sourced from Box Office Mojo and including re-releases. 48 original features ranked (sequels excluded), missing = 53. Pre-1960 grosses are incomplete (Dumbo $1.6M, Alice $5.2M), so this source favors modern films.

sources.name: FinanceBuzz: most-searched animated Disney movie in each state (Google Trends, past 12 months). Disney Animation films: The Lion King 8 states, Tangled 3, Frozen 2; one state each for Bolt, Chicken Little, Aristocats, Hunchback, Jungle Book, Little Mermaid, Princess and the Frog, Moana, 101 Dalmatians, Peter Pan, Pinocchio, Raya and Wreck-It Ralph. The rest of the states went to Pixar or other titles.
sources.method: Google Trends search interest by state, data from Sept-Oct 2021 (page updated Oct 2026). Disney Animation only: LK 1, Tangled 2, Frozen 3, the 13 one-state films 10 each. List length 16, so missing = 21. A noisy search signal.

sources.name: YouGov Ratings, animation movies, Q3 2026 (US). The Lion King is #2 overall at 77% popularity / 97% fame. Topic pages: Moana is the 22nd most popular animation movie (62% pop / 88% fame), Zootopia 32nd (59/85), Encanto 68th (49/71). Pages titled Beauty and the Beast (64/90), Aladdin (57/86) and The Jungle Book (59/84) are filed as 'musical', so the animated film is not certain. Frozen, Tangled, Mulan and the others are below the visible top 20, and their pages could not be found.
sources.method: YouGov's continuous US panel; popularity is the % with a positive opinion. Not averaged, because only a few titles could be read and the rest would get an unfair missing penalty. Used to confirm Lion King at #1 and that Moana, Zootopia and Encanto are the best-liked modern titles.

sources.name: Domestic box office adjusted for ticket-price inflation, all-time top 100. Disney Animation films in it: Snow White #10, 101 Dalmatians #12, The Lion King #19, Fantasia #23, The Jungle Book #36, Sleeping Beauty #37, Pinocchio #48, Bambi #59, Cinderella #70, Lady and the Tramp #90. The #69 Lion King and #83 Beauty and the Beast entries are the remakes.
sources.method: Box Office Mojo adjusted grosses. A secondary signal, not averaged: used only to order the classics in the gut-check moves (Cinderella, Bambi) and to break near-ties.

gut_check: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
changes_vs_current: SCOPE: Walt Disney Animation Studios features only (no Pixar, no live-action remakes; for pageviews and box office, the original animated film's page and gross were used, not the remake's). Sequels (Frozen II, Moana 2, Zootopia 2, Ralph Breaks the Internet) are not separate entries and are not aliased to the originals. Players are asked for 'Disney animated movies' and the titles people name are the originals. Zootopia 2 ($1.86B worldwide, 6.9M pageviews this year) is the closest call if you want sequels in. RAW AVERAGE ORDER (7 people sources): Lion King 4.57, Frozen 4.79, Moana 5.71, Beauty and the Beast 7.43, Aladdin 7.71, Tangled 8.43, Little Mermaid 9.86, Mulan 10.79, Zootopia 11.14, Snow White 12.21, Princess and the Frog 12.71, Lilo & Stitch 13.29, Big Hero 6 13.43, Wreck-It Ralph 14.14, Encanto 14.29, 101 Dalmatians 14.57, Jungle Book 14.57, Hunchback 14.86, Tarzan 14.86, Pocahontas 15.14, Hercules 15.57, Emperor's New Groove 16.14, Chicken Little 16.43, Atlantis 17.00, Bambi 17.14, Fantasia 17.29, Cinderella 17.43, Bolt 17.43, Meet the Robinsons 17.43, Pinocchio 18.00, Peter Pan 18.43, Lady and the Tramp 18.50, Sleeping Beauty 19.43. GUT-CHECK MOVES: (1) Cinderella, raw #27, moved to #9. It is the #1 favorite princess (YouGov 13%), #3 in Tellwut (essentially tied with BatB), and #70 all-time in inflation-adjusted box office. Only pageviews (#39) and nominal gross (#31, a 1950 release) put it low, and both are age-skewed. (2) Bambi, raw #25, moved to #15, not into the top 12: it is the top Tellwut write-in and #59 all-time adjusted, but pageviews (#32) and nominal gross (#22) do put it lower, so it moves only partway. (3) Lilo & Stitch placed #12 (raw #12 before Cinderella was inserted) ahead of Princess and the Frog to keep it inside the gut-check 12, supported by pageviews #7 and box office #12. Chicken Little (raw #23) and Atlantis (raw #24) drop out to make room. Neither is a name typical adults offer; both ride one-state search wins and pageview bumps. All other gut-check films (LK, Frozen, Aladdin, BatB, Little Mermaid, Snow White, Moana, Tangled, Mulan) were already in the raw top 10. MOVES VS CURRENT LIST (Oct 7): Lion King stays #1. Frozen up 5->2 (in every multi-film source, #2 domestic gross, Nielsen top 10 two years running). Moana up 4->3. Aladdin down 2->5 and Beauty and the Beast down 3->4, essentially tied with Moana. Tangled up from #24 (a no-data placeholder) to #6: pageviews #5, gross #8, 2nd-most state wins on Google search, in the YouGov princess set. Little Mermaid up 21->7 (in 6 of 7 sources; won a state in both the Upgraded Points poll and FinanceBuzz). Mulan up 11->8. Cinderella down 6->9 and Snow White down 7->10: the old ranks leaned on inflation-adjusted gross, which is now secondary. NEW: Zootopia (#11; pageviews #1, gross #3, YouGov 59% popular), Lilo & Stitch (#12), Princess and the Frog (#13), Big Hero 6 (#14), Wreck-It Ralph (#16), Encanto (#17; Nielsen #2 in 2023 and #1 in 2022, low only on pandemic-era gross and missing from the older polls), Emperor's New Groove (#24; won Colorado in Upgraded Points). DOWN: Jungle Book 8->19, 101 Dalmatians 19->18 (about level), Hercules 12->23, Tarzan 10->21, Pocahontas 17->22, Hunchback 23->20, Bambi 22->15 (up, via the gut check). OUT: Fantasia (was 9, raw #26), Dumbo (13, raw ~#40), Sleeping Beauty (14, raw #35), Pinocchio (15, raw #30), Alice in Wonderland (16), Peter Pan (18, raw #31), Robin Hood (20). The current list's pre-2000 search data (2020 OnBuy/Ahrefs) and the Rotten Tomatoes fan bracket were not reused: the first is stale and excludes post-1999 films, the second is an enthusiast bracket.
confidence: Top 5 (Lion King, Frozen, Moana, BatB, Aladdin): high for membership, medium for order. Lion King is #1 in 5 of 7 sources plus YouGov Ratings; Frozen/Moana/BatB/Aladdin are within 3 average points of each other. 6-12: medium. Tangled, Little Mermaid, Mulan and Snow White are solid. Cinderella at #9 is a gut-check placement (supported by YouGov favorite-princess data and Tellwut). Zootopia may be inflated by the Zootopia 2 release year. 13-24: low-medium, since averages are packed between 12.7 and 16.1 and order is soft. Near misses: Fantasia, Peter Pan, Sleeping Beauty, Pinocchio, Lady and the Tramp, Dumbo, Atlantis, Chicken Little, Robin Hood. A classics-heavy audience would rank Peter Pan and Sleeping Beauty above Wreck-It Ralph and Big Hero 6. Could not read: a full YouGov Ratings list for Disney titles (the data API was off-limits and most title pages could not be found), so Frozen, Tangled and Mulan have no YouGov popularity numbers; the names and numbers of the 7 unnamed films in the YouGov princess poll; the CableTV.com Google Trends state map (only text, no full table); Google Trends directly. Ranker was not used. No Talker Research/OnePoll poll specifically on favorite Disney animated film was found; the closest Talker poll (Dec 2025) is about the live-action Lilo & Stitch remake. Tellwut is an opt-in panel with a closed 7-title list, and FinanceBuzz search data is from 2021.
